question: What is the name of the high schooler who has the greatest number of friends?
reference_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

final.sql:
SELECT H.name
FROM Highschooler H
JOIN (SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Friend GROUP BY student_id) F
ON H.ID = F.student_id
ORDER BY F.cnt DESC
LIMIT 1
